# Exact MF residual of the literal group `E`

Date: 2026-08-19.

Write

```text
B = iota(mathcal B),
d = t c t^-1,
u = [d,v_1],
D = <<u>>^E.
```

Then

```text
Res_MF(E) = D = N_conj,
E/D ~= Sigma *_B (B x C_2),
```

and `E/D` is MF.  The collapse defect in the sign-free quotient therefore
computes its MF residual exactly.

## 1. `N_conj` is normally generated by `u`

The relations give `[d,tBt^-1]=1`.  In the affine base,

```text
B = Z^3 semidirect L,
tBt^-1 = (2Z^3) semidirect L,
L = <x,y,z>.
```

Hence `d` commutes with the linear part and with every even translation, so
`[d,b]` depends only on the translation parity.  The reduction of `L` modulo
2 is transitive on the seven nonzero vectors of `(F_2)^3`, by the explicit
seven-word calculation already used for the literal block geometry.  A zero
parity class gives the trivial commutator; for a nonzero class choose
`ell in L` carrying `e_1` to it.  Removing an even translation gives

```text
[d,b] = ell [d,v_1] ell^-1 = ell u ell^-1.
```

Conversely `u` is one of the defining compression commutators.  Therefore

```text
N_conj = <<[d,b] : b in B>>^E = <<u>>^E = D.
```

## 2. Quotient presentation

In `E/D`, `d` centralizes `B` and remains an involution.  Use `d` as the lamp
generator and recover `c=t^-1 d t`.  The old relation `[c,B]=1`, after
conjugation by `t`, is `[d,tBt^-1]=1`, redundant because `tBt^-1<=B`.
The mark relations are redundant because `w=u^2=1`.  Thus

```text
E/D = <B,t,d |
       tbt^-1=alpha(b),
       d^2=1,
       [d,B]=1>.
```

With `Sigma=<B,t | tbt^-1=alpha(b)>`, this is exactly

```text
E/D ~= Sigma *_B (B x C_2).
```

Using `c` instead gives the conjugate amalgamating subgroup `t^-1Bt`; the two
forms are equivalent.

## 3. MF of the quotient

The manuscript's rational matrix model realizes `Sigma` as a finitely
generated subgroup of `GL_4(Q)`, hence it is residually finite by Mal'cev.
Therefore `G_0=Sigma x C_2` is residually finite and MF.

Shulman, arXiv:2603.13564v2, Theorem 10, proves that the double of an MF group
over an arbitrary subgroup is MF.  Its weak-group-MF scope is source-verified
in `research/artifacts/shulman-2603-13564-verified.md` and represented by the
established Cairn claim `symmetric-double-weak-mf`.  Apply it to

```text
G_0 *_B G_0,
```

where `B` is embedded as `B x {1}` in each vertex group.

The natural homomorphism

```text
Sigma *_B (B x C_2) -> G_0 *_B G_0
```

sends `Sigma` into the first vertex group and `B x C_2` into the second.  A
reduced source word remains a reduced alternating word in the target, so the
amalgam normal-form theorem makes this map injective.  Subgroups of MF groups
are MF.  Hence `E/D` is MF.

## 4. Exact residual

`unsquared-defect-mf-invisible` proves that every norm-corona homomorphism
kills `u`; kernels are normal, hence `D<=Res_MF(E)`.  Since `E/D` is MF,
compose the quotient map with a faithful corona embedding of `E/D`.  Its
kernel is `D`, and the residual is contained in the kernel of every corona
homomorphism.  Thus `Res_MF(E)<=D`, so

```text
Res_MF(E)=D=N_conj=<<u>>.
```

## 5. Exact collapse downstairs

Let `q:E->E/<w>`.  Since `w=u^2`, `<w><=D`, and residual pullback gives

```text
Res_MF(E/<w>) = D/<w>.
```

The image of `d` is the involutive orbit witness used in the sign-free proof.
Its base commutators normally generate `D/<w>`, so `D/<w><=D_coll`.  The
general collapse theorem gives the reverse inclusion
`D_coll<=Res_MF(E/<w>)`.  Hence

```text
D_coll = Res_MF(E/<w>) = D/<w>,
Res_MF(E) = q^-1(D_coll).
```

## Trust boundary

Already formalized: MF-invisibility of `u`; residual pullback; collapse-defect
inclusion; universal MF quotient machinery.  Paper-level here: the equality
`N_conj=<<u>>`, the quotient presentation, and the normal-form embedding into
the Shulman double.  External input: Shulman's verified double theorem and
classical Mal'cev residual finiteness for finitely generated linear groups.
